title: Promotion of `nextBid` to `topBid` can be delayed until no new bids are submitted
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** Medium  **Likelihood:** Medium  ## Description  When there is no topBid in the amAMM, nextBid cannot be promoted to topBid until K epochs have passed since the epoch when the last topBid was set. This means that each time the nextBid is updated the promotion to topBid is delayed by `current epoch - previous nextBid epoch`.  Let's take the following example:  - At epoch 100 there is no topBid and a new nextBid is created. The next manager can be set at epoch 124. - At epoch 120 a higher nextBid is created. The next manager now cannot be set until epoch 144. - At epoch 1
